contextRadiusLines.description: Lines of unchanged context added on each side of a changed span before overlapping spans are merged.

maxFetchBytesPerFile.description: Largest decoded file the wrapper will read. A larger file is accounted as fileTooLarge rather than partially read.

siblingContextSlices.description: Slices of UNCHANGED text delivered next to the change, per file. Zero disables sibling evidence, which makes adoption-dependent conventions unreportable by a specialist that requires unchanged-sibling proof.

maxTotalSiblingBytes.description: Separate whole-pull-request budget for UNCHANGED sibling context. Kept apart from maxTotalSliceBytes on purpose: when the two shared one pool, the sibling evidence attached to an early file could consume the allowance a later file's changed hunks needed, so adding established-practice context silently lowered changed-source coverage elsewhere in the same pull request. NOTE: the loader additionally refuses any policy whose worst-case rendered size - maxTotalSliceBytes + maxTotalSiblingBytes + maxFiles * (maxSlicesPerFile + siblingContextSlices) * 700 - exceeds the 4194304-byte sealed-block render bound. JSON Schema cannot express that relation, so a policy can satisfy this file and still be refused at load.

minDeliveredFiles.description: Fail-closed floor: fewer FULLY delivered changed files than this fails the cycle instead of producing a review. A partially delivered file does not count.

minDeliveredSpanPercent.description: Fail-closed floor on delivered changed-line spans, so a change set where every file arrived only partially cannot pass on file counts alone.
